items.name: Finder
items.summary: A forward substring searcher using the Rabin-Karp algorithm.

methods.name: find
methods.summary: Return the first occurrence of the `needle` in the `haystack` given. If no such occurrence exists, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: find_raw
methods.signature: unsafe fn find_raw(&self, hstart: *const u8, hend: *const u8, nstart: *const u8, nend: *const u8) -> Option<*const u8>
methods.summary: Like `find`, but accepts and returns raw pointers.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new Rabin-Karp forward searcher for the given `needle`.

items.name: FinderRev
items.summary: A reverse substring searcher using the Rabin-Karp algorithm.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new Rabin-Karp reverse searcher for the given `needle`.

methods.name: rfind
methods.summary: Return the last occurrence of the `needle` in the `haystack` given. If no such occurrence exists, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: rfind_raw
methods.signature: unsafe fn rfind_raw(&self, hstart: *const u8, hend: *const u8, nstart: *const u8, nend: *const u8) -> Option<*const u8>
methods.summary: Like `rfind`, but accepts and returns raw pointers.
